prior_importants.description: The `pup` skill table still says launches also hold when the plan's 5-hour window is at 85%. The PR removed that hold in code, in the conductor kickoff and in ADR 0156, but not here.

findings.description: ADR 0156 is a landed decision, but this PR edits its text in place and also adds an amendment, so the original two-window wording is lost. `docs/adr/README.md` says a later change "appends an amendment section to it (dated, with the PR) … It does not rewrite the landed text." The new `*Amended 2026-11-09: …*` line also names no PR, unlike its siblings (e.g. `*Amended 2026-10-14 (PR #142):*` in ADR 0038). Restore the landed paragraphs and keep only the amendment, adding `(PR #307)`.

process_issues.description: Skipped the review-consolidator: only one finding (a nit) came back from all reviewers, so there was nothing to group. Areas not spawned because their gates did not hold: context, simplicity (the diff only removes code), maintainability, workflow-safety, and spec (no spec source).
